_comment: Source of truth for the India community guidelines table (legal/build.py) and a seed reference for the category_policy table. Default policy from brief Section 3.1; an Indian lawyer must confirm it before launch. Anything uncertain starts as blocked.

categories.licence: IRDAI-registered insurer, insurance broker, corporate agent or insurance web aggregator only, with the IRDAI registration number and validity shown on the profile and each quote.
categories.disclaimer: Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. {{COMPANY_NAME}} is not an insurer, insurance intermediary or web aggregator registered with IRDAI and does not solicit or sell insurance. Quotes are provided by the IRDAI-registered entity named on the quote (IRDAI Reg. No. <shown on each quote>). For details on risk factors, terms, conditions and exclusions, read the sales brochure carefully before concluding a sale.

categories.licence: Real estate agent registered with the State RERA authority (agent registration number shown); projects quoted must show their RERA project registration number where registration is required.
categories.disclaimer: Verify the RERA registration of the project and agent on the State RERA website before making any payment. {{COMPANY_NAME}} is not a real estate agent and is not party to any property transaction.

categories.licence: Not available (Bar Council of India Rules restrict solicitation and advertising by advocates).

Practitioner registered with the National Medical Commission or a State Medical Council (or the relevant council for dental, AYUSH and allied practice); registration number shown. No prescriptions or teleconsultations through the app.
categories.disclaimer: {{APP_NAME}} does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Do not share detailed health information in requests or chat. In an emergency call 112.

categories.licence: Not available (e-cigarettes are prohibited under the PECA 2019).

categories.category: Firearms, ammunition, weapons and weapon parts

categories.licence: None at platform level. Electrical work must be carried out by persons holding the licence or certificate required by the State electricity rules.
categories.disclaimer: Ask your contractor for the relevant licence or certificate for electrical and gas work.

categories.licence: None at platform level; GSTIN recommended for a Verified badge.
categories.disclaimer: Ask for a written lorry receipt / goods consignment note and transit insurance details before your goods are loaded.

categories.licence: None at platform level. Seller must hold the RC or be an authorised dealer.
categories.disclaimer: Check the RC, insurance, PUC certificate and challan history before you pay, and complete the RTO ownership transfer.

categories.category: Everyday goods (appliances, electronics, furniture) and home services
categories.licence: None beyond seller verification (GSTIN, shop photo, optional Udyam number). Some appliances must carry a BIS/ISI mark.
categories.disclaimer: Prices include GST unless the quote says otherwise. Ask for a GST invoice.
